title: Resume an SDDC Manager domain snapshot after token expiry
prompt:
Implement the root Go package `domainsnapshot` (module `vcf91-0026`, standard library only) as a VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 SDDC Manager integration. An inventory access token expires after page 0 has succeeded. Refresh it and resume only the interrupted page without losing, duplicating, or refetching completed work.

The protected `docs/contract.json` is a focused projection of `specifications/sddc-manager/sddc-manager-openapi.json` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository at the exact commit recorded in `docs/official_sources.json`. It was derived from that OpenAPI specification, not a rendered documentation page. The only operationIds in scope are `createToken`, `refreshAccessToken`, and `getDomains`; do not contact any other SDDC Manager route.

Keep this public surface in `client.go`:

- `NewClient(Config) (*Client, error)`, where `Config` contains `BaseURL`, `Username`, `Password`, `HTTPClient`, and `PageSize`. Treat `BaseURL` as an HTTP(S) origin: reject embedded credentials, a query, a fragment, or a non-root path. Reject blank credentials and page sizes outside the positive signed-int32 range before traffic. A nil HTTP client means `http.DefaultClient`. Construction performs no network I/O.
- `TokenCreationSpec` has exact JSON properties `username`, `password`, optional `apiKey`, and optional `idToken`. Use presence-aware pointer fields with `omitempty` for both optionals. Authentication must send a `TokenCreationSpec` containing only username and password; unset optionals must be absent, never empty strings or null.
- `(*Client).ListDomains(context.Context) ([]Domain, error)` returns all intact domain JSON objects in validated page order. `Domain` is `map[string]any`, so fields outside the focused schema projection are preserved.
- `APIError` exposes `OperationID`, `StatusCode`, `ErrorCode`, and `Message`. `ProtocolError` exposes `OperationID` and `Reason`. Their `Error` text, and all transport-error text returned by the package, must not expose the username, password, access token, refresh-token ID, response body, or underlying transport exception text. Preserve `context.Canceled` and `context.DeadlineExceeded` for `errors.Is`.

Authenticate lazily once during the inventory run with `createToken`: exactly `POST /v1/tokens`, compact UTF-8 JSON, `Accept: application/json`, `Content-Type: application/json`, no query, and no Authorization header. Accept exactly HTTP 201 and require a JSON object with a non-empty string `accessToken` and non-empty string `refreshToken.id`.

Retrieve zero-based `getDomains` pages starting at 0. Each request is exactly `GET /v1/domains?pageNumber=N&pageSize=S`, with `pageNumber` before `pageSize`, `Accept: application/json`, and `Authorization: Bearer <current token>`. GET requests have no body or `Content-Type`. Do not send unset optional query fields (`type`, `name`, `vcFqdn`, `vcInstanceId`, `isManagementSsoDomain`, or `useCache`) as empty values. Accept exactly HTTP 200.

Validate every successful PageOfDomain before appending it. It must contain an `elements` array of JSON objects and `pageMetadata` with present signed-int32 `pageNumber`, `pageSize`, `totalElements`, and `totalPages`. Values must be non-negative; the page number must match the request; returned page size must equal the element count; a response may not exceed the requested size; totals must remain consistent; and total pages must equal the ceiling of total elements divided by the requested size (zero for an empty collection). Reject a page outside the advertised range, a short/empty non-final page, an overshoot, or a final element count different from `totalElements`. Return `*ProtocolError`, never a partial collection.

On the first HTTP 401 from `getDomains` only, call `refreshAccessToken` exactly once. Send exactly `PATCH /v1/tokens/access-token/refresh` with the saved refresh-token ID encoded as a compact JSON string, `Accept: application/json`, `Content-Type: application/json`, and no Authorization header. Accept exactly HTTP 200 containing a non-empty JSON string, replace the access token, and retry only the failed page once. Never recreate the token pair, restart pagination, refetch page 0, append the failed response, or append the retried page twice. A second 401 or any refresh failure is terminal. Do not retry any other failure.

Run `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30s ./...`. The protected tests start the supplied contract-pinned mock on an ephemeral `127.0.0.1` port, generate credentials and tokens at runtime, and inspect its race-safe request log. The mock serves only the three operationIds named by the contract. The verifier checks provenance, exact methods, targets, query order, headers, compact bodies, optional omission, operation order, one-time refresh, same-page retry, preservation of prior work, page validation, exact success statuses, error redaction, and local validation. No live VMware endpoint is contacted. `contract_test.go`, `go.mod`, `docs/`, and `internal/contractmock/` are protected; edit only `client.go`.
